entries.label: Step-B correction: Home one-gradient header 2026-10-20
entries.scope: Home EXTENDED-BAND backdrop ONLY. Nav-row ramp, title 16/600, 44dp slots, 16dp inset, back label, Details goBack and the shared avatar clip were NOT touched.
entries.rootCause: The band was already a SINGLE SOLID (AppHeader/styles.ts bandBackdrop -> headerSpec.background.bandBackdrop) and the header already had exactly ONE LinearGradient (AppHeader.tsx:116, the nav-row strip) - no second gradient, no leftover old/vertical ramp. The visible double colour was a hard STEP at the strip/band boundary: the strip bottom edge is the ramp BRIGHT end on the left (#BE110F measured) while the band was painted the ramp DARK start stop (#2A0508).
entries.fix: headerSpec.background.bandBackdrop reuses the ramp END STOP instead of its start stop - one token, no new hex, no new gradient.
entries.measuredBefore: strip bottom (y=156) x8=#BE110F -> band (y=158) #2A0508 = hard red->maroon step; band column x8 y160..400 = #2A0508 solid
entries.measuredAfter: strip bottom (y=156) x8=#BE110F -> band (y=158) #C0110F = 2-value step; band column x8 y160..400 = #C0110F single colour; header now holds only the ramp two stops (#2A0508, #C0110F)
entries.note: Task text named #160F12 as the band colour, but that is the PRE-D1 vertical ramp end stop, not a colour in the D1 ramp (['#2A0508','#C0110F']); using it would add a third tone AND make the left step a red->near-black cliff, i.e. keep the very seam to remove. The ramp actual end stop was used instead.
